_comment: ONE-SHOT CAPTURE of real host state, taken at the FB-0107 plan gate on
2026-09-12 BEFORE the session-start hook was registered and BEFORE any
`claude plugin update` ran. This is the perishable artifact: the workspace
it was taken in updates itself from here on, and a CI runner has no
~/.claude/plugins at all, so this state cannot be re-observed by a reviewer.
Its role is to pin the ENGINE's reading of the twelve-release skew that
FB-0107 reports, against the independently-measured table in the PR body.
It is deliberately NOT a synthetic fixture: the other files in this
directory are, and they are what the behavioural assertions run against.
Absolute paths scrubbed -- they are host-specific and are not what this pins.
host: Conductor cloud workspace (Vercel sandbox, Amazon Linux 2023, x86_64)
note_on_predicates: report_drift is TRUE while update_available is FALSE. This is the live case critique finding (1) predicted and the reason the two predicates are not one boolean: the marketplace CLONE is pinned at the same stale commit as the install, so there is nothing newer to fetch locally, while the branch is 12 releases ahead. A single `drift` flag could not express this.
